annotations.title: Funding rate history: hourly Hyperliquid perp funding rates and APR

description: Past hourly funding rates of a Hyperliquid perpetual (BTC, ETH, SOL…): each rate with its premium and time, plus the average rate and its annualised APR over the window. Up to 500 hours back (default 24). Read from Hyperliquid's public API. Use to compare carry over time, spot funding regime changes, or backtest basis and funding-arbitrage strategies; for the current rate use hyperliquid_market. Example: coin=ETH. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

coin.description: Coin symbol such as BTC, ETH, SOL or HYPE (default ETH)
